#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

SRC = "report.pdf"
OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
TMP_COVER = "_cover_page.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    sys.exit(f"ERROR: {SRC} not found in the workspace")

reader = PdfReader(SRC)
print(f"Input pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

# Match the cover page size to the first page of report.pdf
first = reader.pages[0]
mb = first.mediabox
x0, y0 = float(mb.lower_left[0]), float(mb.lower_left[1])
x1, y1 = float(mb.upper_right[0]), float(mb.upper_right[1])
page_w = x1 - x0
page_h = y1 - y0
print(f"Page size: {page_w:.0f} x {page_h:.0f} pts")

# Current date
today = datetime.date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover date: {date_str}")

# Create the cover page
c = canvas.Canvas(TMP_COVER, pagesize=(page_w, page_h))
cx = (x0 + x1) / 2.0
cy = (y0 + y1) / 2.0

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.2)
c.drawCentredString(cx, cy + 40, "Annual Financial Report")

# Date
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.35, 0.35, 0.4)
c.drawCentredString(cx, cy - 20, date_str)

# Decorative rule
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.5, 0.55, 0.65)
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(cx - 150, cy - 2, cx + 150, cy - 2)

c.save()

# Merge cover + original pages
cover_reader = PdfReader(TMP_COVER)
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

# Validate by reading the output back
check = PdfReader(OUT)
print(f"Output written: {OUT}")
print(f"Output pages: {len(check.pages)}")
cover_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " | ")
print(f"Cover page text: {cover_text}")

assert len(check.pages) == len(reader.pages) + 1, "Page count mismatch"
assert "Annual Financial Report" in cover_text, "Title missing on cover"
assert date_str in cover_text, "Date missing on cover"
print("Validation OK: title and date present on cover page")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

Pure standard-library implementation (no third-party PDF libraries are
installed in this environment). Strategy: keep the original report.pdf bytes
verbatim, append new PDF objects (cover content stream, cover page, new
Pages tree, new root Catalog), and write a fresh xref table + trailer.
"""
import datetime
import os
import re
import zlib

SRC = "report.pdf"
OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
PREVIEW_DIR = "preview"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Standard Helvetica AFM widths (units per 1000 em) for printable ASCII.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HELV = {
    32: 278, 33: 278, 34: 355, 35: 556, 36: 556, 37: 889, 38: 667, 39: 191,
    40: 333, 41: 333, 42: 389, 43: 584, 44: 278, 45: 333, 46: 278, 47: 278,
    48: 556, 49: 556, 50: 556, 51: 556, 52: 556, 53: 556, 54: 556, 55: 556,
    56: 556, 57: 556, 58: 278, 59: 278, 60: 584, 61: 584, 62: 584, 63: 556,
    64: 1015, 65: 667, 66: 667, 67: 722, 68: 722, 69: 667, 70: 611, 71: 778,
    72: 722, 73: 278, 74: 500, 75: 667, 76: 556, 77: 833, 78: 722, 79: 778,
    80: 667, 81: 778, 82: 722, 83: 667, 84: 611, 85: 722, 86: 667, 87: 944,
    88: 667, 89: 667, 90: 611, 91: 278, 92: 278, 93: 278, 94: 469, 95: 556,
    96: 333, 97: 556, 98: 556, 99: 500, 100: 556, 101: 556, 102: 278,
    103: 556, 104: 556, 105: 278, 106: 278, 107: 556, 108: 278, 109: 833,
    110: 556, 111: 556, 112: 556, 113: 556, 114: 333, 115: 500, 116: 278,
    117: 556, 118: 500, 119: 722, 120: 500, 121: 500, 122: 500, 123: 334,
    124: 260, 125: 334, 126: 584,
}


def text_width(s, size):
    return sum(HELV.get(ord(c), 556) for c in s) * size / 1000.0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Minimal PDF tokenizer / parser (stdlib only).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
WS = b" \t\r\n\0\f"
DELIMS = b"()<>[]{}/%"


def tokenize(data):
    tokens = []
    i, n = 0, len(data)
    while i < n:
        b = data[i:i + 1]
        if b in WS:
            i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"%":
            while i < n and data[i:i + 1] not in (b"\r", b"\n"):
                i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"(":
            start, depth = i, 1
            i += 1
            while i < n and depth:
                c = data[i:i + 1]
                if c == b"\\":
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if c == b"(":
                    depth += 1
                elif c == b")":
                    depth -= 1
                i += 1
            tokens.append(("lit", data[start:i]))
            continue
        if b == b"<":
            if data[i:i + 2] == b"<<":
                tokens.append(("kw", "<<"))
                i += 2
                continue
            j = data.find(b">", i)
            tokens.append(("hex", data[i:j + 1]))
            i = j + 1
            continue
        if b == b">":
            tokens.append(("kw", ">>"))
            i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"[":
            tokens.append(("kw", "["))
            i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"]":
            tokens.append(("kw", "]"))
            i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"/":
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and data[j:j + 1] not in WS and data[j:j + 1] not in DELIMS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(("name", data[i:j]))
            i = j
            continue
        j = i
        while j < n and data[j:j + 1] not in WS and data[j:j + 1] not in DELIMS:
            j += 1
        raw = data[i:j]
        i = j
        if re.fullmatch(rb"[+-]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)", raw):
            tokens.append(("num", float(raw) if b"." in raw else int(raw)))
        else:
            tokens.append(("kw", raw.decode("latin-1")))
    return tokens


def parse_value(tokens, i):
    kind, val = tokens[i]
    if kind == "kw":
        if val == "<<":
            d = {}
            i += 1
            while tokens[i][1] != ">>":
                key = tokens[i][1].decode("latin-1")
                i += 1
                v, i = parse_value(tokens, i)
                d[key] = v
            return d, i + 1
        if val == "[":
            arr = []
            i += 1
            while tokens[i][1] != "]":
                v, i = parse_value(tokens, i)
                arr.append(v)
            return arr, i + 1
        if val == "true":
            return True, i + 1
        if val == "false":
            return False, i + 1
        if val == "null":
            return None, i + 1
        raise ValueError(f"unexpected keyword: {val}")
    if kind == "num":
        if (i + 2 < len(tokens) and tokens[i + 1][0] == "num"
                and tokens[i + 2] == ("kw", "R")):
            return (int(val), int(tokens[i + 1][1])), i + 3
        return val, i + 1
    if kind == "name":
        return val, i + 1
    if kind == "lit":
        return val, i + 1
    if kind == "hex":
        return val, i + 1
    raise ValueError(f"cannot parse token: {tokens[i]}")


def render(v):
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        body = " ".join(f"{k} {render(x)}" for k, x in v.items())
        return f"<< {body} >>"
    if isinstance(v, list):
        return "[" + " ".join(render(x) for x in v) + "]"
    if isinstance(v, tuple):
        return f"{v[0]} {v[1]} R"
    if isinstance(v, bytes):
        return v.decode("latin-1")
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return "true" if v else "false"
    if v is None:
        return "null"
    if isinstance(v, float):
        return f"{v:g}"
    return str(v)


def parse_xref(data, xref_off):
    """Parse a classic xref table; return (entries, trailer_dict)."""
    entries = {}
    pos = xref_off
    m = re.match(rb"xref\s+", data[pos:])
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("no xref table at offset")
    pos += m.end()
    while True:
        m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+", data[pos:])
        if not m:
            break
        start, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for k in range(count):
            line = data[pos:pos + 20]
            off = int(line[0:10])
            gen = int(line[11:16])
            free = line[17:18] == b"f"
            entries[start + k] = (off, gen, free)
            pos += 20
    m = re.search(rb"trailer\s*(<<.*?>>)", data[pos:], re.S)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("no trailer found")
    toks = tokenize(m.group(1))
    trailer, _ = parse_value(toks, 0)
    return entries, trailer


def read_object(data, offset):
    """Return (parsed_object_dict_or_value, raw_object_bytes)."""
    end = data.find(b"endobj", offset)
    raw = data[offset:end]
    s = raw.find(b"stream")
    if s != -1:  # stream object: only tokenize the header dict
        toks = tokenize(raw[:s])
        val, _ = parse_value(toks, 3)
    else:
        toks = tokenize(raw)
        val, _ = parse_value(toks, 3)
    return val, raw


def get_stream(raw):
    s = raw.find(b"stream")
    ds = s + len(b"stream")
    if raw[ds:ds + 2] == b"\r\n":
        ds += 2
    elif raw[ds:ds + 1] == b"\n":
        ds += 1
    de = raw.rfind(b"endstream")
    return raw[ds:de]


def extract_text(data, entries, obj):
    cont = obj.get("/Contents")
    refs = []
    if isinstance(cont, tuple):
        refs.append(cont)
    elif isinstance(cont, list):
        refs = [r for r in cont if isinstance(r, tuple)]
    chunks = []
    for ref in refs:
        off = entries[ref[0]][0]
        d, raw = read_object(data, off)
        stream = get_stream(raw)
        flt = d.get("/Filter")
        if flt == "/FlateDecode" or (isinstance(flt, list) and flt and flt[0] == "/FlateDecode"):
            try:
                stream = zlib.decompress(stream)
            except Exception:
                pass
        chunks.append(stream)
    joined = b"".join(chunks)
    parts = re.findall(rb"\(((?:[^()\\]|\\.)*)\)\s*Tj", joined)
    out = []
    for p in parts:
        s = p.replace(b"\\(", b"(").replace(b"\\)", b")").replace(b"\\\\", b"\\")
        s = re.sub(rb"\\([0-7]{1,3})", lambda mm: bytes([int(mm.group(1), 8)]), s)
        out.append(s.decode("latin-1"))
    return " ".join(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main flow
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {SRC} not found")

data = open(SRC, "rb").read()

# 1. Locate and parse the original xref table / trailer.
m = re.findall(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
xref_off = int(m[-1])
entries, trailer = parse_xref(data, xref_off)
print(f"Original objects in xref: {len(entries)}, trailer keys: {sorted(trailer)}")

root_ref = trailer["/Root"]
root = read_object(data, entries[root_ref[0]][0])[0]
pages_ref = root["/Pages"]
pages = read_object(data, entries[pages_ref[0]][0])[0]
kids = pages["/Kids"]
count = int(pages["/Count"])
first_page = read_object(data, entries[kids[0][0]][0])[0]
mbox = first_page.get("/MediaBox") or pages.get("/MediaBox") or [0, 0, 612, 792]
w = float(mbox[2]) - float(mbox[0])
h = float(mbox[3]) - float(mbox[1])
print(f"Original pages: {count}, page size: {w:.0f} x {h:.0f} pts")

# 2. Build the cover content.
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover title: 'Annual Financial Report', date: '{date_str}'")

title = "Annual Financial Report"
title_w = text_width(title, 32)
date_w = text_width(date_str, 18)
tx = (w - title_w) / 2.0
ty = h * 0.62
dx = (w - date_w) / 2.0
dy = h * 0.62 - 70.0
rule_x = (w - 240.0) / 2.0
rule_y = h * 0.62 - 38.0

content = (
    f"BT\n/F2 32 Tf\n{tx:.2f} {ty:.2f} Td\n({title}) Tj\nET\n"
    f"0.45 0.48 0.55 rg\n{rule_x:.2f} {rule_y:.2f} 240 1.5 re f\n"
    f"0 0 0 rg\n"
    f"BT\n/F1 18 Tf\n{dx:.2f} {dy:.2f} Td\n({date_str}) Tj\nET\n"
).encode("latin-1")

# 3. Create the new objects.
max_obj = max(entries)
content_obj = max_obj + 1
page_obj = max_obj + 2
new_pages_obj = max_obj + 3
new_root_obj = max_obj + 4

font_res = ("<< /F1 << /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >> "
            "/F2 << /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >> >>")
cover_page = (f"<< /Type /Page /Parent {new_pages_obj} 0 R "
              f"/MediaBox [{' '.join(render(v) for v in mbox)}] "
              f"/Resources << /Font {font_res} >> /Contents {content_obj} 0 R >>")

new_kids = [page_obj] + kids
kids_str = " ".join(f"{k[0]} 0 R" for k in new_kids)
pages_extra = " ".join(f"{k} {render(v)}" for k, v in pages.items()
                       if k not in ("/Type", "/Kids", "/Count"))
new_pages = (f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids_str}] /Count {count + 1} "
             f"{pages_extra} >>")

root_extra = " ".join(f"{k} {render(v)}" for k, v in root.items()
                      if k not in ("/Type", "/Pages"))
new_root = (f"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages {new_pages_obj} 0 R "
            f"{root_extra} >>")

# 4. Assemble output: original bytes + new objects + new xref + trailer.
out = bytearray(data)
out += b"\n"


def add_obj(num, body):
    start = len(out)
    out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
    out += body
    out += b"\nendobj\n"
    return start


content_stream = (f"<< /Length {len(content)} >>\nstream\n".encode("latin-1")
                  + content + b"\nendstream")
c_off = add_obj(content_obj, content_stream)
p_off = add_obj(page_obj, cover_page.encode("latin-1"))
np_off = add_obj(new_pages_obj, new_pages.encode("latin-1"))
nr_off = add_obj(new_root_obj, new_root.encode("latin-1"))

new_size = max_obj + 5
xref_pos = len(out)
out += b"xref\n"
out += f"0 {new_size}\n".encode("latin-1")
out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for num in range(1, max_obj + 1):
    off, gen, free = entries.get(num, (0, 0, True))
    typ = "f" if free else "n"
    out += f"{off:010d} {gen:05d} {typ} \n".encode("latin-1")
for off in (c_off, p_off, np_off, nr_off):
    out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")

out += b"trailer\n"
trailer_body = f"<< /Size {new_size} /Root {new_root_obj} 0 R"
info = trailer.get("/Info")
if info:
    trailer_body += f" /Info {info[0]} {info[1]} R"
id_m = re.search(rb"/ID\s*(\[[^\]]*\])", data)
if id_m:
    trailer_body += " /ID " + id_m.group(1).decode("latin-1")
trailer_body += " >>"
out += trailer_body.encode("latin-1")
out += b"\n"
out += f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode("latin-1")

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    f.write(bytes(out))
print(f"Wrote {OUT} ({len(out)} bytes)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validation (round-trip with the same mini-parser).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
data2 = open(OUT, "rb").read()
m2 = re.findall(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data2)
entries2, trailer2 = parse_xref(data2, int(m2[-1]))
root2 = read_object(data2, entries2[trailer2["/Root"][0]][0])[0]
pages2 = read_object(data2, entries2[root2["/Pages"][0]][0])[0]
kids2 = pages2["/Kids"]
print(f"Validation: output pages = {len(kids2)} (expected {count + 1})")
assert len(kids2) == count + 1, "page count mismatch"

cover_text = extract_text(data2, entries2, read_object(data2, entries2[kids2[0][0]][0])[0])
print(f"Cover page text: {cover_text!r}")
assert "Annual Financial Report" in cover_text, "title missing on cover"
assert date_str in cover_text, "date missing on cover"

orig_first = extract_text(data, entries, read_object(data, entries[kids[0][0]][0])[0])
new_second = extract_text(data2, entries2, read_object(data2, entries2[kids2[1][0]][0])[0])
print(f"Original page 1 text: {orig_first!r}")
print(f"Output page 2 text:   {new_second!r}")
assert orig_first == new_second, "original content changed!"

print("VALIDATION OK: cover page prepended, original content intact")

os.makedirs(PREVIEW_DIR, exist_ok=True)
print(f"Preview directory ready: {PREVIEW_DIR}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

SRC = "report.pdf"
OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
TMP_COVER = "_cover_page.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    sys.exit(f"ERROR: {SRC} not found in the workspace")

reader = PdfReader(SRC)
print(f"Input pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

# Match the cover page size to the first page of report.pdf
first = reader.pages[0]
mb = first.mediabox
x0, y0 = float(mb.lower_left[0]), float(mb.lower_left[1])
x1, y1 = float(mb.upper_right[0]), float(mb.upper_right[1])
page_w = x1 - x0
page_h = y1 - y0
print(f"Page size: {page_w:.0f} x {page_h:.0f} pts")

# Current date
today = datetime.date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover date: {date_str}")

# Create the cover page
c = canvas.Canvas(TMP_COVER, pagesize=(page_w, page_h))
cx = (x0 + x1) / 2.0
cy = (y0 + y1) / 2.0

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.2)
c.drawCentredString(cx, cy + 40, "Annual Financial Report")

# Date
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.35, 0.35, 0.4)
c.drawCentredString(cx, cy - 20, date_str)

# Decorative rule
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.5, 0.55, 0.65)
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(cx - 150, cy - 2, cx + 150, cy - 2)

c.save()

# Merge cover + original pages
cover_reader = PdfReader(TMP_COVER)
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

# Validate by reading the output back
check = PdfReader(OUT)
print(f"Output written: {OUT}")
print(f"Output pages: {len(check.pages)}")
cover_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " | ")
print(f"Cover page text: {cover_text}")

assert len(check.pages) == len(reader.pages) + 1, "Page count mismatch"
assert "Annual Financial Report" in cover_text, "Title missing on cover"
assert date_str in cover_text, "Date missing on cover"
print("Validation OK: title and date present on cover page")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

Pure standard-library implementation (no third-party PDF libraries are
installed in this environment). Strategy: keep the original report.pdf bytes
verbatim, append new PDF objects (cover content stream, cover page, new
Pages tree, new root Catalog), and write a fresh xref table + trailer.
"""
import datetime
import os
import re
import zlib

SRC = "report.pdf"
OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
PREVIEW_DIR = "preview"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Standard Helvetica AFM widths (units per 1000 em) for printable ASCII.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HELV = {
    32: 278, 33: 278, 34: 355, 35: 556, 36: 556, 37: 889, 38: 667, 39: 191,
    40: 333, 41: 333, 42: 389, 43: 584, 44: 278, 45: 333, 46: 278, 47: 278,
    48: 556, 49: 556, 50: 556, 51: 556, 52: 556, 53: 556, 54: 556, 55: 556,
    56: 556, 57: 556, 58: 278, 59: 278, 60: 584, 61: 584, 62: 584, 63: 556,
    64: 1015, 65: 667, 66: 667, 67: 722, 68: 722, 69: 667, 70: 611, 71: 778,
    72: 722, 73: 278, 74: 500, 75: 667, 76: 556, 77: 833, 78: 722, 79: 778,
    80: 667, 81: 778, 82: 722, 83: 667, 84: 611, 85: 722, 86: 667, 87: 944,
    88: 667, 89: 667, 90: 611, 91: 278, 92: 278, 93: 278, 94: 469, 95: 556,
    96: 333, 97: 556, 98: 556, 99: 500, 100: 556, 101: 556, 102: 278,
    103: 556, 104: 556, 105: 278, 106: 278, 107: 556, 108: 278, 109: 833,
    110: 556, 111: 556, 112: 556, 113: 556, 114: 333, 115: 500, 116: 278,
    117: 556, 118: 500, 119: 722, 120: 500, 121: 500, 122: 500, 123: 334,
    124: 260, 125: 334, 126: 584,
}


def text_width(s, size):
    return sum(HELV.get(ord(c), 556) for c in s) * size / 1000.0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Minimal PDF tokenizer / parser (stdlib only).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
WS = b" \t\r\n\0\f"
DELIMS = b"()<>[]{}/%"


def tokenize(data):
    tokens = []
    i, n = 0, len(data)
    while i < n:
        b = data[i:i + 1]
        if b in WS:
            i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"%":
            while i < n and data[i:i + 1] not in (b"\r", b"\n"):
                i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"(":
            start, depth = i, 1
            i += 1
            while i < n and depth:
                c = data[i:i + 1]
                if c == b"\\":
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if c == b"(":
                    depth += 1
                elif c == b")":
                    depth -= 1
                i += 1
            tokens.append(("lit", data[start:i]))
            continue
        if b == b"<":
            if data[i:i + 2] == b"<<":
                tokens.append(("kw", "<<"))
                i += 2
                continue
            j = data.find(b">", i)
            tokens.append(("hex", data[i:j + 1]))
            i = j + 1
            continue
        if b == b">":
            tokens.append(("kw", ">>"))
            i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"[":
            tokens.append(("kw", "["))
            i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"]":
            tokens.append(("kw", "]"))
            i += 1
            continue
        if b == b"/":
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and data[j:j + 1] not in WS and data[j:j + 1] not in DELIMS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(("name", data[i:j]))
            i = j
            continue
        j = i
        while j < n and data[j:j + 1] not in WS and data[j:j + 1] not in DELIMS:
            j += 1
        raw = data[i:j]
        i = j
        if re.fullmatch(rb"[+-]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)", raw):
            tokens.append(("num", float(raw) if b"." in raw else int(raw)))
        else:
            tokens.append(("kw", raw.decode("latin-1")))
    return tokens


def parse_value(tokens, i):
    kind, val = tokens[i]
    if kind == "kw":
        if val == "<<":
            d = {}
            i += 1
            while tokens[i][1] != ">>":
                key = tokens[i][1].decode("latin-1")
                i += 1
                v, i = parse_value(tokens, i)
                d[key] = v
            return d, i + 1
        if val == "[":
            arr = []
            i += 1
            while tokens[i][1] != "]":
                v, i = parse_value(tokens, i)
                arr.append(v)
            return arr, i + 1
        if val == "true":
            return True, i + 1
        if val == "false":
            return False, i + 1
        if val == "null":
            return None, i + 1
        raise ValueError(f"unexpected keyword: {val}")
    if kind == "num":
        if (i + 2 < len(tokens) and tokens[i + 1][0] == "num"
                and tokens[i + 2] == ("kw", "R")):
            return (int(val), int(tokens[i + 1][1])), i + 3
        return val, i + 1
    if kind == "name":
        return val, i + 1
    if kind == "lit":
        return val, i + 1
    if kind == "hex":
        return val, i + 1
    raise ValueError(f"cannot parse token: {tokens[i]}")


def render(v):
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        body = " ".join(f"{k} {render(x)}" for k, x in v.items())
        return f"<< {body} >>"
    if isinstance(v, list):
        return "[" + " ".join(render(x) for x in v) + "]"
    if isinstance(v, tuple):
        return f"{v[0]} {v[1]} R"
    if isinstance(v, bytes):
        return v.decode("latin-1")
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return "true" if v else "false"
    if v is None:
        return "null"
    if isinstance(v, float):
        return f"{v:g}"
    return str(v)


def parse_xref(data, xref_off):
    """Parse a classic xref table; return (entries, trailer_dict)."""
    entries = {}
    pos = xref_off
    m = re.match(rb"xref\s+", data[pos:])
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("no xref table at offset")
    pos += m.end()
    while True:
        m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+", data[pos:])
        if not m:
            break
        start, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for k in range(count):
            line = data[pos:pos + 20]
            off = int(line[0:10])
            gen = int(line[11:16])
            free = line[17:18] == b"f"
            entries[start + k] = (off, gen, free)
            pos += 20
    m = re.search(rb"trailer\s*(<<.*?>>)", data[pos:], re.S)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("no trailer found")
    toks = tokenize(m.group(1))
    trailer, _ = parse_value(toks, 0)
    return entries, trailer


def read_object(data, offset):
    """Return (parsed_object_dict_or_value, raw_object_bytes)."""
    end = data.find(b"endobj", offset)
    raw = data[offset:end]
    s = raw.find(b"stream")
    if s != -1:  # stream object: only tokenize the header dict
        toks = tokenize(raw[:s])
        val, _ = parse_value(toks, 3)
    else:
        toks = tokenize(raw)
        val, _ = parse_value(toks, 3)
    return val, raw


def get_stream(raw):
    s = raw.find(b"stream")
    ds = s + len(b"stream")
    if raw[ds:ds + 2] == b"\r\n":
        ds += 2
    elif raw[ds:ds + 1] == b"\n":
        ds += 1
    de = raw.rfind(b"endstream")
    return raw[ds:de]


def extract_text(data, entries, obj):
    cont = obj.get("/Contents")
    refs = []
    if isinstance(cont, tuple):
        refs.append(cont)
    elif isinstance(cont, list):
        refs = [r for r in cont if isinstance(r, tuple)]
    chunks = []
    for ref in refs:
        off = entries[ref[0]][0]
        d, raw = read_object(data, off)
        stream = get_stream(raw)
        flt = d.get("/Filter")
        if flt == "/FlateDecode" or (isinstance(flt, list) and flt and flt[0] == "/FlateDecode"):
            try:
                stream = zlib.decompress(stream)
            except Exception:
                pass
        chunks.append(stream)
    joined = b"".join(chunks)
    parts = re.findall(rb"\(((?:[^()\\]|\\.)*)\)\s*Tj", joined)
    out = []
    for p in parts:
        s = p.replace(b"\\(", b"(").replace(b"\\)", b")").replace(b"\\\\", b"\\")
        s = re.sub(rb"\\([0-7]{1,3})", lambda mm: bytes([int(mm.group(1), 8)]), s)
        out.append(s.decode("latin-1"))
    return " ".join(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main flow
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {SRC} not found")

data = open(SRC, "rb").read()

# 1. Locate and parse the original xref table / trailer.
m = re.findall(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
xref_off = int(m[-1])
entries, trailer = parse_xref(data, xref_off)
print(f"Original objects in xref: {len(entries)}, trailer keys: {sorted(trailer)}")

root_ref = trailer["/Root"]
root = read_object(data, entries[root_ref[0]][0])[0]
pages_ref = root["/Pages"]
pages = read_object(data, entries[pages_ref[0]][0])[0]
kids = pages["/Kids"]
count = int(pages["/Count"])
first_page = read_object(data, entries[kids[0][0]][0])[0]
mbox = first_page.get("/MediaBox") or pages.get("/MediaBox") or [0, 0, 612, 792]
w = float(mbox[2]) - float(mbox[0])
h = float(mbox[3]) - float(mbox[1])
print(f"Original pages: {count}, page size: {w:.0f} x {h:.0f} pts")

# 2. Build the cover content.
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover title: 'Annual Financial Report', date: '{date_str}'")

title = "Annual Financial Report"
title_w = text_width(title, 32)
date_w = text_width(date_str, 18)
tx = (w - title_w) / 2.0
ty = h * 0.62
dx = (w - date_w) / 2.0
dy = h * 0.62 - 70.0
rule_x = (w - 240.0) / 2.0
rule_y = h * 0.62 - 38.0

content = (
    f"BT\n/F2 32 Tf\n{tx:.2f} {ty:.2f} Td\n({title}) Tj\nET\n"
    f"0.45 0.48 0.55 rg\n{rule_x:.2f} {rule_y:.2f} 240 1.5 re f\n"
    f"0 0 0 rg\n"
    f"BT\n/F1 18 Tf\n{dx:.2f} {dy:.2f} Td\n({date_str}) Tj\nET\n"
).encode("latin-1")

# 3. Create the new objects.
max_obj = max(entries)
content_obj = max_obj + 1
page_obj = max_obj + 2
new_pages_obj = max_obj + 3
new_root_obj = max_obj + 4

font_res = ("<< /F1 << /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >> "
            "/F2 << /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >> >>")
cover_page = (f"<< /Type /Page /Parent {new_pages_obj} 0 R "
              f"/MediaBox [{' '.join(render(v) for v in mbox)}] "
              f"/Resources << /Font {font_res} >> /Contents {content_obj} 0 R >>")

new_kids = [page_obj] + kids
kids_str = " ".join(f"{k[0]} 0 R" for k in new_kids)
pages_extra = " ".join(f"{k} {render(v)}" for k, v in pages.items()
                       if k not in ("/Type", "/Kids", "/Count"))
new_pages = (f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids_str}] /Count {count + 1} "
             f"{pages_extra} >>")

root_extra = " ".join(f"{k} {render(v)}" for k, v in root.items()
                      if k not in ("/Type", "/Pages"))
new_root = (f"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages {new_pages_obj} 0 R "
            f"{root_extra} >>")

# 4. Assemble output: original bytes + new objects + new xref + trailer.
out = bytearray(data)
out += b"\n"


def add_obj(num, body):
    start = len(out)
    out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
    out += body
    out += b"\nendobj\n"
    return start


content_stream = (f"<< /Length {len(content)} >>\nstream\n".encode("latin-1")
                  + content + b"\nendstream")
c_off = add_obj(content_obj, content_stream)
p_off = add_obj(page_obj, cover_page.encode("latin-1"))
np_off = add_obj(new_pages_obj, new_pages.encode("latin-1"))
nr_off = add_obj(new_root_obj, new_root.encode("latin-1"))

new_size = max_obj + 5
xref_pos = len(out)
out += b"xref\n"
out += f"0 {new_size}\n".encode("latin-1")
out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for num in range(1, max_obj + 1):
    off, gen, free = entries.get(num, (0, 0, True))
    typ = "f" if free else "n"
    out += f"{off:010d} {gen:05d} {typ} \n".encode("latin-1")
for off in (c_off, p_off, np_off, nr_off):
    out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")

out += b"trailer\n"
trailer_body = f"<< /Size {new_size} /Root {new_root_obj} 0 R"
info = trailer.get("/Info")
if info:
    trailer_body += f" /Info {info[0]} {info[1]} R"
id_m = re.search(rb"/ID\s*(\[[^\]]*\])", data)
if id_m:
    trailer_body += " /ID " + id_m.group(1).decode("latin-1")
trailer_body += " >>"
out += trailer_body.encode("latin-1")
out += b"\n"
out += f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode("latin-1")

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    f.write(bytes(out))
print(f"Wrote {OUT} ({len(out)} bytes)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validation (round-trip with the same mini-parser).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
data2 = open(OUT, "rb").read()
m2 = re.findall(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data2)
entries2, trailer2 = parse_xref(data2, int(m2[-1]))
root2 = read_object(data2, entries2[trailer2["/Root"][0]][0])[0]
pages2 = read_object(data2, entries2[root2["/Pages"][0]][0])[0]
kids2 = pages2["/Kids"]
print(f"Validation: output pages = {len(kids2)} (expected {count + 1})")
assert len(kids2) == count + 1, "page count mismatch"

cover_text = extract_text(data2, entries2, read_object(data2, entries2[kids2[0][0]][0])[0])
print(f"Cover page text: {cover_text!r}")
assert "Annual Financial Report" in cover_text, "title missing on cover"
assert date_str in cover_text, "date missing on cover"

orig_first = extract_text(data, entries, read_object(data, entries[kids[0][0]][0])[0])
new_second = extract_text(data2, entries2, read_object(data2, entries2[kids2[1][0]][0])[0])
print(f"Original page 1 text: {orig_first!r}")
print(f"Output page 2 text:   {new_second!r}")
assert orig_first == new_second, "original content changed!"

print("VALIDATION OK: cover page prepended, original content intact")

os.makedirs(PREVIEW_DIR, exist_ok=True)
print(f"Preview directory ready: {PREVIEW_DIR}")
